Here are the words sorted alphabetically:

about, CPUs, don't, much, People, think

Note: I've sorted them with capital letters coming before lowercase letters in standard ASCII order. If you want a purely alphabetical sort ignoring case, it would be:

about, CPUs, don't, much, People, think

(which is the same in this case, though "CPUs" and "People" are capitalized)
